Flight · Latvia

Drone of unknown origin enters Latvian airspace near Russian border

17 May 2026 · Latvian–Russian border

Reported incursion; origin unresolved

On 17 May 2026 a drone was reported to have entered Latvian airspace near the border with Russia and later to have left it. The Latvian military reportedly tracked the temporary incursion. The precise location of the incursion has not been established.

The drone’s operator and model are unknown, and it has not been finally identified. Any link to Ukraine rests only on suspicion drawn from the wider context, not on an identification of this drone.

The drone was monitored and no shoot-down was reported. No damage or other impact was reported.
